sequential_dependency.intermediate: The ordered vector of selected horizontal-candidate indices, one entry per selector with duplicate selections retained.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Identify every exact blue vertical-three selector and exact blue horizontal-three candidate, order candidates by top-left cell, and compute for each selector the candidate with minimum cell-to-cell Manhattan distance using reading order to break ties.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Paint red the union of horizontal-three candidates referenced by that vector while leaving every other cell unchanged.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Candidate identities depend on the input-specific selector-to-candidate distance matrix. The renderer cannot know which horizontal triples to recolor until Stage A produces those indices; replacing the qualified vector [1, 5, 5] with the first-N vector [0, 1, 2] changes the final protected-Racket output.
